headline: Lindenwood top the table on the fewest goals conceded
dek: Lindenwood have conceded 16 goals across every match they have played this season, winning eight and losing five. It has been enough to top the table by a point from SIUE and UIW, though they lost both of their matches in November.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Scoring did not decide the table: Eastern Illinois conceded 39 goals across all its matches, more than any other OVC side, and its attack carried it only to the bottom half.

wire.line: HCU were the last OVC side to take the field this season, and lost at Bryant.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches past their date carry no result, all of them August home matches, for UIW, SIUE and Western Illinois.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Diego Robles scored eleven of UIW's 25 goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southern Indiana lost ten matches, more than any other OVC program.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fifteen different players scored for Lindenwood.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Harvey Heeps made 75 saves in HCU's goal.

last_match.line: HCU came to Bryant unbeaten through November, with wins over UTRGV and Lindenwood and draws against Western Illinois and Eastern Illinois.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
